Person IDs derive only from append-only internal slots. Name-only staff evidence remains candidate/review/unresolved and never becomes a durable mapping.

The repository pointer binds a content-addressed external 589,377-row, 47-column CSV by exact SHA-256, size, schema, dataset version, and eligibility. Two independent builds reproduced SHA-256 0ab6acafbe350a4958a5fca1c02a9c51463ab8a93ecc173a57b9fd925bf2198d.

Provider quota, empty portal partitions, partial assistant-staff history, unresolved team aliases, candidate matches, and all 699 review/unresolved outcomes remain explicit. No player-value, PIT, model, protected-performance, A&M-lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or final historical-readiness result is claimed.
